The Children and Youth program helps children grow as their Savior did and share their gifts and talents with others. As children focus on gospel learning, service, and personal growth, they begin to act like Heavenly Father and His Son and make themselves, other people, and even the world better. Seechildrenandyouth.ChurchofJesusChrist.org.
